# Vendored from Playwright-SAP

Unmodified source files from https://github.com/ArpitSureka/playwright-sap
(branch `sap/dev`, commit `bdb25c6ea218764fa756f5460b4e63519dda6c5e`, version 1.1.6),
licensed under Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`). `isomorphic/` holds the three
Playwright files (Copyright Microsoft Corporation) the engines import.

Paths map to the fork's repo as follows:

- `injected/sap/` → `packages/injected/src/sap/`
- `sap/` → `packages/sap/`
- `isomorphic/` → `packages/playwright-core/src/utils/isomorphic/`

Do not edit these files; `../engines.ts` bundles them as they are.
